The Proposal: -
To control air and water pollution in the state and to increase the bank guarantee of industries.
The Hon'ble Minister (Environment) has given assurances. In which the bank guarantee of the enterprises (the amount of the deposit)
Promises of expansion, inspection of the industrial sector and constitution of a committee for pollution control.
are provided. In keeping with these promises, Shri. given by the Minister (Environment)
Department of Environment and Climate Change, Department of Industries, concerned public representatives and industry as per the directive.
The government was considering forming a committee consisting of experts in the field.
The government's decision:
To take appropriate decisions to curb air and water pollution in the state and to increase the bank guarantee of industries.
The committee is being constituted as follows:
The committee is headed by the Hon'ble Minister, Department of Environment and Climate Change.
The rights and duties shall be as follows: -
1) Experts on increasing the bank guarantee (deposit amount) of industries in the industrial sector in the state.
to study in coordination.
2) To suggest technical measures and policy decisions to curb air and water pollution in the state.
